title: Wikipedia
infra
tagline: Unremarkable but important code: a calendar module that runs on 1.4 million pages of Russian Wikipedia.

blocks.label: What I built
blocks.text: A Lua module that merged years of drifted calendar templates into one maintained implementation, running on 1.4M pages.

blocks.label: Also in production
blocks.text: talk-snapshots: a service on Wikimedia Toolforge that stores snapshots of discussion pages across seven wikis. I built, deployed and maintain it myself: readiness and health probes, CI with action versions pinned to SHAs.

blocks.label: Result
blocks.text: The least eye-catching project here and the most widely deployed. Owning production means the system keeps working even when nobody is watching.

blocks.label: Stack
blocks.text: Lua (Scribunto) for the module · Python 3.13, GitHub Actions with pinned SHAs, ruff, Dependabot, buildpacks, Toolforge for the service
